headline: VQ-128 d_l=16 (CEM): exploitation x5.8, wins 94%

high search: CEM, 16 segments x 1500 samples x 40 steps
CEM solve time: 225.8203 seconds

=== 1. model exploitation: predicted terminal cost ‖ẑ_H − z_goal‖² ===
  CEM selected macro-actions      : median     25.45   p90    141.33
  expert macro-actions            : median    148.34   p90    275.25
  -> the model believes CEM's plan beats the expert's by x5.8
  -> CEM 'beats' the expert on 94% of segments

=== 2. cost/subgoal mismatch ===
  first-waypoint error vs the true frame:
    CEM subgoal      : median     37.49
    expert           : median     55.30
  corr(terminal cost, first-waypoint error): Spearman +0.771   Pearson +0.476
    (n=16: |r| > 0.54 is significant at p=0.05; Spearman is significant.
     Positive r means lower cost goes with a better subgoal, i.e. the
     horizon-2 objective is not actively selecting bad subgoals.)
